name: Tally
description: Forms and their submissions on Tally.
long_description: Tally's hosted server. It lists your forms and reads their submissions, so the answers people sent you can be summarised in the chat instead of exported to a spreadsheet first.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Tally in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reads your forms and the answers people sent them, which are other people's words.
